label: Diagram 8.1
caption: Diagram 8.1 | Height of controls Prevention of falls
description: This is a section drawing titled "Diagram 8.1 Height of controls", with the note "See para 8.1" at the top left. It shows a vertical section through a window. On the left, a tall vertical member represents the window frame; a small symbol at its top is pointed to by a leader line labelled "Control". Above it, a horizontal line with an arrow at its left end, labelled "Window", points to the vertical line at the control. Beneath it, a horizontal dimension arrow marked "600mm max. to control" measures the gap between that vertical line and a vertical dashed line to the right. A horizontal ledge projects to the right from the vertical member at about mid-height. A vertical arrow from the floor line to the top of this ledge is marked "900mm max.". A further vertical arrow on the right runs from the floor line up to the level of the control, indicated by a horizontal dashed line, and is labelled "Not more than 1700mm if obstructed; or 1900mm if unobstructed". A green banner at the bottom carries the title.
